accountant_is_configured.meaning: The Vault has an Accountant configured

slot_registration_active_before_call.meaning: An active registration exists for the target BLP slot before the call

slot_readable_and_active_verified.meaning: The supplied slot has been verified as readable and active

distributable_surplus_calculation_succee.meaning: The distributableSurplus() calculation required by Gate 3 succeeds

yield_settlement_blocked_observed.meaning: Yield settlement is blocked because Gate 3 needs a successful distributableSurplus() calculation

assumptions: The target BLP slot is the 0x811 supplied-balance slot referenced by the report.
notifyVaultSupply is the registration action whose ordering is constrained by the intent.

unresolved.description: The intent states an ordering requirement (verify readable/active before calling notifyVaultSupply); the required_effect template expresses a completion obligation rather than a strict before/after ordering, so the ordering relation is only approximated.
The report does not state a deterministic trigger for HyperCore leaving the slot inactive, so the scenario leading to the blocked settlement is conditional and not fully specified.

limitations: The safety relation is encoded as a required-effect obligation (verification holds when notifyVaultSupply is called) rather than a strict temporal ordering, because the fixed pattern grammar for sequence_preservation uses required_effect.
The impact is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric magnitude for the blocked settlement.
